rules: R6 overrides every conflicting historical value
Unfrozen parking/service facilities without permanent IDs are excluded
Undergraduate dorm footprints remain a 78-82m range; no silent midpoint is chosen before its footprint policy is explicitly resolved
External roads and perimeter wall reuse the already-authoritative Stage A R6 files instead of duplicating a second coordinate set
SVG coordinate mapping is frozen and may not auto-fit current geometry
One world meter equals one SVG user unit inside the map frame
World X maps right; world Z maps upward by inversion into SVG Y
Presentation profile may translate the map group but may not scale it
Step 3 perimeter wall openings are true geometry gaps computed by projecting each frozen gate/interface target to the nearest wall segment
Step 3 external road centerlines remain the exact R6 piecewise-linear source chains; rounded SVG joins are visual styling only and do not create new engineering centerlines
No raster image elements are permitted in generated masterplan SVG files
nextStep: Step 4: add current internal roads, Chenghu and R6 water system, squares and major open-space geometry to both deterministic SVG profiles.
